preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call enableBlacklist function
Target victim address must not already be blacklisted

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call enableBlacklist(victim_address) function with the target address as parameter. This will set blacklist[victim_address] = true, preventing the victim from sending or receiving tokens. The _transfer function checks isBlacklisted(msg.sender), isBlacklisted(recipient), and isBlacklisted(tx.origin), so blacklisted addresses cannot participate in any token transfers. Verify the exploit succeeded by checking isBlacklisted(victim_address) returns true after the call.
